q01:
We are ahead of pace to date, but if nothing changes we land at 57,329 doors on Election Day, 3,303 short of the 60,632 goal.
- Pace to date (Sep 21 to Oct 18): 33503 doors vs a goal to date of 32431, 103.3% of goal to date [table:v_office_pace_total]
- Last 7 days (Oct 12 to 18): 1489.1 doors a day on average, with 16 knocking days left [table:v_office_pace_total]
- Projected total: 57329 doors, 94.6% of the 60632 goal [table:v_office_pace_total]
- Projected vs goal: -3303, the shortfall if nothing changes [table:v_office_pace_total]
- Method: the projection is doors to date plus the last 7 days' average daily doors times the knocking days left [doc:program-plan#pace-and-projection]
q03:
Eastgate needs 4.4 more shifts a day, Harbor 1.3 more, and Northside none; the program as a whole needs 4.1 more shifts a day.
- Eastgate: 12.6 shifts a day needed vs 8.3 a day in the last 7 days (Oct 12 to 18), so 4.4 extra [table:v_office_pace]
- Harbor: 11.1 needed vs 9.9 now, so 1.3 extra [table:v_office_pace]
- Northside: 10.1 needed vs 11.1 now, so 0 extra [table:v_office_pace]
- Program total: 33.3 needed vs 29.3 now, so 4.1 extra [table:v_office_pace_total]
- Method: doors still needed divided by the 16 knocking days left, divided by the last 7 days' doors per shift; extra shifts is that minus the last 7 days' average shifts per day [doc:program-plan#shifts-needed]
q05:
Ask the client for more doors first: at our current pace we will knock more doors than are left untouched in our turf, so we'll run out of first-pass turf.
- Capacity for the rest of the program: 1489.1 doors a day (last 7 days, Oct 12 to 18) x 16 knocking days left; the projection rises from 33503 doors to date to 57329 [table:v_office_pace_total]
- Untouched doors left in our turf: 10393 of 41853 turf doors [table:v_office_pace_total]
- By office, untouched doors: Eastgate 1183, Harbor 8096, Northside 1114 [table:v_office_pace]
- Rule: when capacity is larger than the untouched doors, ask the client for more doors first; new turf contacts voters at the normal first-pass rate [doc:program-plan#more-doors-or-a-second-pass]
- A second pass on not-home doors is the fallback, because second passes contact voters at roughly half the first-pass rate [doc:program-plan#more-doors-or-a-second-pass]
q07:
The client's sheet counts attempts before any QC rollback, while our dashboard counts each door once per day with rollbacks removed; on Oct 12 most of the gap is Eastgate's 142 rolled-back attempts.
- Program, Oct 12: the client sheet shows 1484 (attempts), our dashboard 1281 doors, with 142 rolled-back attempts [table:v_daily_doors_total]
- Eastgate: client 498 vs our 342 doors; 142 of its attempts were rolled back [table:client_daily_report] [table:v_daily_doors]
- Harbor: client 428 vs our 406 doors, 0 rolled back, so the gap is repeat attempts [table:client_daily_report] [table:v_daily_doors]
- Northside: client 558 vs our 533 doors, 0 rolled back, so the gap is repeat attempts [table:client_daily_report] [table:v_daily_doors]
- How it works: the gap is repeat attempts at the same door plus attempts later rolled back; a normal day is a few percent, and a larger gap almost always means a rollback [doc:counting-doors#why-the-client-s-numbers-differ-from-ours]
q09:
Contact rates are up overall this week (Oct 12 to 18) vs last week (Oct 5 to 11), rising in Northside and Harbor but falling in Eastgate.

x04:
Flash knocking is recording doors faster than a person can walk to them and knock; a shift is flagged when 10 or more consecutive knocks are recorded less than 30 seconds apart.
- Threshold: 10 or more consecutive knocks, each less than 30 seconds apart [doc:qc-rules#flash-knocking]
- Confirmed flash knocking is rolled back: the knocks in the window no longer count as doors or contacts, and a whole shift recorded this way is rolled back in full [doc:qc-rules#flash-knocking]
- Rolled-back knocks stay in the data marked rolled back but are removed from doors and contacts [doc:counting-doors#rollbacks]
- Every open flag needs a field lead conversation before the canvasser's next shift; two or more in one week for the same canvasser go to the field director [doc:qc-rules#what-happens-after-a-flag]
